scope: Targeted checks, not independent verification of all records. No subscribed UpToDate content was accessible.

references.title: 2025 Neonatal Resuscitation Guidelines and Algorithm
references.scope: Supports ventilation-first interpretation for Q1-Q2; qualifications only for Q3-Q4. Does not resolve incomplete recall details.

references.title: Neonatal immune-mediated thrombocytopenia
references.scope: Attempt made for Q8-Q9. Not used as independently reviewed evidence.

references.title: Congenital Syphilis - STI Treatment Guidelines
references.scope: Q19 requires infant findings, relative titer, adequacy/timing of maternal treatment and follow-up. Less-likely scenario uses at least 30 days, not merely four weeks. Does not establish a unique choice.

references.title: Guidelines for Perinatal Post-Vaccination Serologic Testing
references.scope: Supports Q20: HBsAg and anti-HBs at 9-12 months, or 1-2 months after a delayed series is completed.

references.title: Diagnosis of HIV Infection in Infants and Children
references.scope: Q21: HIV RNA and HIV DNA NAT are generally equally recommended; the preserved DNA-only key is not uniquely supported.

references.title: Clinical Protocol #36: The Mastitis Spectrum, Revised 2022
references.scope: Q40: cooling and limited hand expression may be appropriate; heat can aggravate inflammation. Context and technique matter. No automatic replacement answer assigned.
